startUrls.title: Websites to monitor
startUrls.description: One or more websites (home page URL), e.g. https://example.com. Only pages on the same hostname are crawled. Add all your client sites to monitor them in one scheduled run.

startUrl.title: Website URL (single site, legacy)
startUrl.description: Kept for backward compatibility. Use "Websites to monitor" instead.

maxPages.title: Max pages per site
maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to audit per website. You pay per audited page, so this also caps the cost of a run. Keep it the same between scheduled runs for fair comparisons.

monitorChanges.title: Compare with the previous run
monitorChanges.sectionDescription: Schedule this Actor (e.g. weekly) and every run is compared with the previous run of the same site.
monitorChanges.description: Save results in your account (key-value store "seo-ai-monitor-state") and report what changed since the last run: score drops, pages that became noindex, newly blocked AI crawlers, new broken links, removed llms.txt or sitemap.

alertWebhookUrl.title: Alert webhook URL (Slack, Discord, Make, Zapier, n8n)
alertWebhookUrl.description: Optional. A Slack or Discord incoming webhook, or any URL that accepts a JSON POST. You get a short message listing the regressions and a link to the report.

alertOn.title: Send alert when
alertOn.description: When to call the alert webhook.

scoreDropThreshold.title: Score change threshold (points)
scoreDropThreshold.description: A site or page score change smaller than this is ignored.

failOnRegression.title: Mark run as failed on regression
failOnRegression.description: Mark the run as failed when something got worse. Useful with Apify's built-in email notifications for failed runs (no webhook needed).

checkExternalLinks.title: Check external links
checkExternalLinks.description: Also check up to 300 outbound links per site for 404s (slower).

generateLlmsTxt.title: Generate llms.txt draft
generateLlmsTxt.description: Build a ready-to-publish llms.txt file from the crawled pages (saved as the "llms.txt" record in the key-value store).

language.title: Report language
language.description: Language of the issue texts, alerts and the HTML report.
